contribution_requirements: Pin every new dependency exactly (no ^ or ~ in package.json; pyproject exact pins). Do not break the existing 186 backend tests. Keep spec in sync: .kiro/specs/heatwise-ai/tasks.md 3.1-3.4 checked with findings, design.md new section 9 (M3), README run/verify steps. No personal data stored (community-level profile only, no names/phones). No external actions. Safety rule: on needs_human_review the UI renders only verification.verified_item_ids under a 'Not verified - needs human review' banner; rejected items in recommended_actions never render as advice; checklist download uses report.checklist_markdown. Incomplete reports show missing information and no plan. Every report view shows the informational-tool disclaimer and report.notices. Accessibility: keyboard for every control, visible focus, landmarks and labels, WCAG AA contrast, risk colour always with a text label, responsive to 390px. Framer Motion sparingly, respect prefers-reduced-motion. Taste-skill app-screen house rules: no gradients, glows, icons in tinted squares, rainbow charts or invented vanity numbers. Do not create markdown files beyond the spec/README updates the task asks for.
